page.overview:
Who is Captain Tylik?

Captain Tylik is a Kislevite officer who leads a detachment (a rota) of 20 Ungol horse archers who have been stationed at The Picket fortification in the Middle Mountains that watches over the nearby Brass Keep and its Nurglish inhabitants. He and his troops are baffled as to why they have been tasked with guarding a mountain pass, an unsuitable task for a cavalry unit. Still, Middenheim and Kislev exchange troops on a yearly basis in honour of old alliances, and the Kislevites serve without complaint.

A veteran of many wars, Tylik is a short, scarred figure, his dark moustache beginning to go grey. Tylik cares little for politics, instead judging based on merit. He is also impressed with good horsemanship or skill at arms. Any attempt to smooth-talk him is likely to backfire, unless it's accompanied by strong drink like kvas.
